newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha trims loss, physical interest picks up.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha trims loss, physical interest picks up.

text.p: NWE naphtha trimmed its losses to end slightly lower after a recovery in crude and gasoline, traders said on Wednesday.
Heightened interest in the wet market was seen with November at hand but no deals were confirmed.
Traders said a Skikda cargo was on offer in the Med by an end user at flat to a premium to the Algerian formula, with buyers wanting a discount.
A Suez cargo was still on offer at $226-$227 cif NWE with bids at $224, they said.
